text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's debut race was magnificent. 
Ferocious, wild--truly the running of the strong-- 
she will become the one and only strongest, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
With that run in mind, I considered her race schedule. 
Her speed is first-class, but she still has 
immature places, in body and in spirit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
So I decided to devote her Junior year to training 
and aim for the Classic races. 
The next goal is the Kyodo News Hai.
